questions.question: What does @SpringBootTest do?
options: Starts the full Spring application context for the test
Runs the test in a separate JVM without Spring
Deletes the database before each test
questions.explanation: @SpringBootTest builds the full application context with all beans and settings so parts can be tested together.

questions.question: Which webEnvironment starts a real server on a free port?
questions.explanation: RANDOM_PORT starts an embedded server on a free port, and @LocalServerPort injects the chosen port.

questions.question: application.properties has cinema.total-seats=100, 30 seats are booked, and the test uses @SpringBootTest(properties = "cinema.total-seats=50"). What does seatsLeft() return?
questions.explanation: The property on the annotation overrides the file for this test, so 50 minus 30 booked gives 20.

questions.question: Two test classes use exactly the same @SpringBootTest setup. How many times does Spring build the context?
options: Once, because the context is cached
questions.explanation: Spring caches contexts by configuration, so classes with an identical setup share one context.

questions.question: A test uses @LocalServerPort but the app runs with the default @SpringBootTest settings, and the port is 0 or missing. What is the fix?
questions.explanation: The default MOCK environment starts no real server, so there is no port. RANDOM_PORT starts one.
